verdict.rationale: Qodo documents organization-level defaults that apply to all connected repositories. Repository-level overrides are managed from the same central Configurations page in the portal, and config-as-code can also be set at the group or organization level. Its governance docs position this as consistent standards enforced across every repository at scale. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of rollouts across hundreds of repos, and documentation of a consolidated view or audit of which repos override the defaults.

support.subject: As an engineering lead, I roll out org-level review defaults across hundreds of repos and manage exceptions centrally

citations.quote: Organization level (default): Settings apply to all connected repositories. Repository level: Settings apply only to the selected repository and override the organization-level defaults
The recommended way to manage organization-wide and repository-level code review configuration, from the Configurations page in the Qodo portal.
Manage Qodo configuration as code using a .pr\_agent.toml file at the repository, project, group, or organization level.
Qodo governance is built for engineering leaders who need consistent standards enforced across every repository, automatically, at scale, and without manual intervention
